Widget.name: 3D Map
Widget.noWebGL: This map needs WebGL, which this browser does not offer.

Settings.styleUrlHint: A MapLibre style. The default, OpenFreeMap Liberty, is free and needs no key.
Settings.darkStyleUrl: Style in the dark theme (empty: the same)
Settings.rasterUrlHint: An XYZ template ({z}/{x}/{y}). A WMS server is added below as a service.
Settings.rasterInvertDark: Turn the raster base dark in the dark theme
Settings.wmsFailed: This address answers no WMS GetCapabilities.
Settings.attribution: Attribution of the whole map (empty: the one of the style and the raster base)
Settings.attributionHint: Replaces the whole attribution. The attribution the licence of the map data asks for (e.g. © OpenStreetMap contributors) must stay visible. Links are allowed.
Settings.attributionCompact: Fold the attribution behind an i button
Settings.interactive: Users can move, tilt and turn the map
Settings.buildingSourceLayer: Layer of the buildings in the style
Settings.terrainUrlHint: A TileJSON, or elevation tiles with {z}/{x}/{y}.
Settings.widgetSource: The data source of the widget
Settings.thingNamesHint: x* starts with, *x ends with, *x* contains. Only these things are loaded.
Settings.colorSuffix: Datastream of the colour (end of its id)
Settings.colorSuffixHint: Its latest value picks the colour below.
Settings.markerIconHint: A Material Symbols icon, e.g. sensors. Empty: a white dot.
Settings.heightSuffix: Datastream of the height (end of its id)
Settings.refreshSeconds: Read the latest values every (s, 0: once)
Settings.geoJson: GeoJSON (written in, wins over the address)

models.urlHint: The server of the file must allow the board to read it (CORS).
models.placeHint: In the preview: a click adds the model, drag moves it, a right click removes it.

errors.blocked: The file cannot be read: the server does not allow it (no CORS header) or cannot be reached.
errors.http: The server answered with an error ({{status}}).
errors.format: The file is no model in this format.

ModelLayer.name: Name
ModelLayer.scale: Metres per unit of the model (FBX in cm: 0.01)

FieldEncoding.value: Metres without a value (0: the scale)

ColorEncoding.color: Colour without a value (empty: of the file)

PartEncoding.mesh: Meshes (regular expression on their names, e.g. trunk|cylinder)

format.auto: By the ending of the address

scaleType.linear: Linear from a domain to metres

unit.auto: Of the column type, else m
